about: Crusader line (Crusader 1210, Paladin 1310, Royal Guard 1410): skill mechanics SkillConfig does not carry, read from each skill's own description and timeline (SkillMechanics.cs documents every field). Entries are keyed by _iSkillID, so they apply to every _iMode row of the group; groups whose modes disagree (Shield Cast 11610, Blood Cross 11604) are left out and listed in the findings. Everything is (inferred); 'why' quotes the evidence.

group:11404.name: Shield Reflect -> Shield Reflect Auto Counter
group:11404.why: Shield Reflect 11410: 'When you take Melee Physical DMG from an attacker within «5» meters, deals Neutral Melee Physical DMG equal to your PATK * «20»% + «50» to the attacker. This effect can trigger up to «1» times per second'; buff 1140401 _kLogicData [11419] = group 11419 'Shield Reflect Auto Counter' (lv10 row P1 2000 / P2 50 = the text), at the learned Shield Reflect level.

group:11409.name: Recoil -> Recoil Auto Counter (Stun)
group:11409.why: Recoil 11416: 'While [Auto Guard] is active, taking damage from an attacker within «5» meters has a «1»% Chance to inflict [Stun] on them for «1» sec. (Cooldown: «3» sec.)'; buff 1140901 _kLogicData [11420] = row 1142001 'Recoil Auto Counter' whose _kBuff2 is Stun 901601 for 1000 ms. Auto Guard is buff group 11403 (1140301-1140310).

group:11610.name: Reflect Damage -> Thorn
group:11610.why: Reflect Damage 11609: 'When you are hit, deals Neutral Melee Physical DMG equal to PATK * «40»% to up to «5» enemies within a «6»-meter radius. This effect can trigger up to «1» times every «0.5» seconds'; buff 1161001-1161005 _kLogicData [11618, ...] = group 11618 'Thorn' (P1 4000, _kRange 600, 5 targets) at the learned Reflect Damage level.

group:11611.name: Casting Shield -> extra Thorn
group:11611.why: Shield Cast 11610: '[Casting Shield]: When you are hit, triggers an Extra Auto Counter from [Reflect Damage]'; buff 1161101-1161110 _kLogicData [11618] = Thorn, at the Reflect Damage level. The text gives no limit of its own; the «0.5» s of Reflect Damage is reused (inferred) so a pack of monsters cannot release it on every swing.

group:11604.name: Charge Up -> Charge Up Strike
group:11604.why: Heavy Cannon Shot 11602: 'Grants you [Charge Up] for «8» seconds. [Charge Up]: ... The next time you Deals DMG, removes [Charge Up] and triggers [Charge Up Strike] against the primary target, dealing ... «50»% PATK'; buff 1160401-1160410 _kLogicData [11604, 11622, ...] = group 11622 'Charge Up Strike' (P1 5000). Consumed on the first damage after the cast that granted it.

group:11616.name: Shield Defense -> Spear Auto Counter
group:11616.why: Shield Defense 11613: 'When an enemy in front of you Deals DMG to you, trigger [Spear Auto Counter]'; its _kBuff1 1161601-1161610 ('Shield Defense Orbit') _kLogicData [11621, ...] = group 11621 ('... within a «7»-meter semicircle in front of you ... (can only trigger once every «0.5» sec.)'). The «0.5» s Shield Defense cooldown reduction is not modelled.

11610.name: Shield Cast
11610.why: Mode 0: 'Deals Neutral Melee Physical DMG equal to PATK * «100»% to up to «5» enemies within a «5»-meter radius ... Against Monsters, the percentage DMG multiplier increases by «100»%': P1 [10000, 20000] -> branch 1 (200%) against monsters, 5 m around the caster (_kRange 600 = 6 m). Modes 1 and 2 have their own neutral entries below so this does not leak into them.

11610:1.name: Shield Cast (talent mode 1)
11610:1.why: Mode 1 has a single P1 [40000] (no monster branch) and keeps the generic row behaviour; this empty entry only stops the mode 0 entry from applying.

11610:2.name: Holy Light Suppression (Shield Cast mode 2)
11610:2.why: Mode 2 is a Rect360 '«4» * «8»-meter area in front' that the generic rectangle rule already draws from _kRange; this empty entry only stops the mode 0 circle from applying.

11624:2.name: Earthshaker (Fearless Charge mode 2)
11624:2.why: 'Continuously spins ... dealing a total of PATK * «350»% ... within a «8»-meter radius ... The final HIT inflicts Knockback': P1 [1000, 25000] with 11 attack points = 10 ticks x 10% at points 0-9 plus a final 250% (branch 1) at point 10 = 350%, around the caster (_kRange 800).

11624:3.name: Earthshaker (Fearless Charge mode 3)
11624:3.why: Same row data and text as mode 2 (P1 [1000, 25000], 11 attack points, «8»-meter radius): 10 x 10% then a final 250%.

11607.name: Twilight
11607.why: 'Leap to a selected area within «15» meters, dealing ... to up to «N» enemies within «6» meters of the target area': the damage already lands on the dragged point (DragCircle 6 m); the caster now also moves there (its show has the displacement effect 1160707).

11411.name: Holy Cross
11411.why: 'Deals Holy melee Physical damage ... to a designated ST enemy within «3» meters': single target, but the row is an area selector (_iRangeType 2, Lock, _kRange [0], _iTargetMax 5), so the 0 m splash around the locked target can also catch monsters standing on it. Both modes (0, 1) say ST.

11601.name: Banishing Thrust
11601.why: '... to up to «5» enemies in a «3» * «5»-meter area in front of you' (width * length, as Heavy Cannon Shot's «5» * «15» for _kRange 1600x500): a 5 m long, 3 m wide strip from the caster; _kRange [650, 300] would make it 6.5 m long.

11602.name: Heavy Cannon Shot
11602.why: '... to up to «5» enemies in a «5» * «15»-meter area in front of you': a 15 m long, 5 m wide strip from the caster (_kRange [1600, 500] is 16 m long). One damage moment (P1 160% = the description's single hit).

11603.name: Pinpoint Attack
11603.why: 'Deals damage equal to @{3}% of Physical ATK to enemies in a @{1}m-long, @{2}m-wide area ahead and moves @{4}m in that direction', _kDescData ['9', '4', '60', '8'] (P1 6000 = 60%): the PinpointAttack displacement moves the caster 8 m before the first attack point, so the 9 x 4 m strip must start where the dash started (anchor caster would measure it from the landing spot, beyond the enemies passed through).

11608.name: Shield Press
11608.why: 'PATK * «200»% ... Against Monsters, the percentage DMG multiplier increases by «100»%': _kDamageParam1 [20000, 40000], branch [1] = 200% x (1 + 100%) is the monster value (Enhanced Shield Press, mode 1: [35000, 70000] for «350»% + «100»%). Server targets are monsters, so hit with branch 1 (_kShowDmg [2, 2] keeps 2 segments). Event players are hit by HitEventPlayersAsync, unaffected.

11611.name: Earth Drive
11611.why: 'PATK * «350»% ... to up to «5» enemies within a «5»-meter radius ... Against Monster targets, the percentage DMG multiplier increases by «100»%': P1 [35000, 70000] -> branch 1 (700%) against monsters, _kShowDmg [3, 3]; the circle is 5 m around the caster (_kRange 650 = 6.5 m).

11613.name: Shield Defense
11613.why: 'Raise your Shield for «5» seconds ... Every «0.5» seconds, inflict a «3»-meter Knockback in the direction you are Facing on up to «5» members of the Enemy Team within «3» meters in front of you and deal ... PATK * «100»%': 10 pulses of the row damage (P1 10000) at attack points 1-10 (template 0.05-0.5 s over the 5000 ms action = every 0.5 s), each around where the caster is (it may walk, _bMovement 1); the area is 3 m deep in front (width 4 m from _kRange[1], the description gives none), and each pulse pushes 3 m away from the caster. The CombatService comment notes this periodic aura was not simulated.

11621.name: Spear Auto Counter
11621.why: '... to up to «5» enemies within a «7»-meter semicircle in front of you': fan of 7 m, 180 degrees (_kRange [800, 180] is 8 m). Proc of Shield Defense (buff 1161610 _kLogicData [11621, ...]); the trigger itself needs engine work.

11624.name: Fearless Charge
11624.why: 'Deals ... PATK * «50»% and inflicts Knockback on up to «5» enemies ... Move ${12} meters in that direction, then inflict Knock-Up and deal ... PATK * «200»% to the targets': _kDamageParam1 [5000, 20000] = first strike (branch 0) at attack point 0 (0.05 s) and the landing strike (branch 1) at the last attack point 2 (0.87 s); generic only dealt the 50%. Modes 2/3 of this group are Earthshaker (P1 [1000, 25000], 11 points) and also get these two moments (10% + 250% instead of the described 350%; still closer than the generic 10%). Modes 2/3 (Earthshaker) now have their own entries, so this one covers Fearless Charge only: the '«8» * «12»-meter area in front' is a 12 m long, 8 m wide strip from where the charge started (anchor origin), since the caster moves 12 m along it (PinpointAttack2 displacement, _kDescData[3] = 12) before the landing strike.

11628.name: Spear Formation - Crescent Moon
11628.why: 'Deals @{1} hits of ... PATK * «50»% to up to «5» enemies within a «5»-meter radius ... You can Move while casting': P1 5000 is per hit; the template has three attack points (0.13, 0.58, 1.12 s) and the sibling EatChicken_2006 row says '@{3} times' with _kDescData 318 = 3 x its P1 10600, so three hits around the caster's current position, 5 m (_kRange 650 = 6.5 m; mode 1 also says «5»). 'Pulls the targets closer' gives no distance: each hit draws them toward the caster, up to the 5 m radius, stopping 1 m short (inferred).

11636.name: Powerful Shield Bash
11636.why: 'PATK * «180»% to the selected ST enemy ... Against Monster targets, the percentage DMG multiplier increases by «50»%': P1 [18000, 27000] (180% x 1.5); mode 1 Ultra Shield Bash «250»% + «50»% = [25000, 37500]. Branch 1 against monsters.

11638.name: Shield Block / Shield Auto Counter / Powerful Auto Counter
11638.why: Mode 4/6 'Shield Auto Counter: PATK * «200»% ... Against Monster targets, the percentage DMG multiplier increases by «100»%' P1 [20000, 40000]; mode 7/9 'Powerful Auto Counter: PATK * «400»%' P1 [40000, 80000]: branch 1 against monsters. Modes 0/3 (the block itself) have no damage params, so the single moment at point 0 only grants _kBuff1 as before.
